title: The beat: rhythm from The Final Countdown and Hurt

blocks.text:
Last lesson you played the riff's keys. Now its **rhythm**: how long each note lasts against a steady beat. You'll use it in every song from here.

**By the end** you can play the rhythm of The Final Countdown's riff and of Hurt's intro in time, and you know quarter, eighth, half, dotted half and whole notes and rests.
# Warm up: the riff by its key names

blocks.title: The Final Countdown riff, by key names

blocks.alt: Whole, half, quarter and eighth notes and their lengths in beats
blocks.caption: Note values and how many beats each lasts in 4/4.

blocks.text: Play the riff's rhythm on the piano: in **Rhythm** mode any key counts and only *when* you play is judged, so all your attention goes on the timing. ▶ plays it first if you want to hear it.

blocks.title: The riff's rhythm
blocks.about: Rhythm mode: any key counts; only the timing is judged.
blocks.doneWhen: 80% of the notes on time in one run

blocks.text:
# Hurt: a long note
The left hand of *Hurt* begins with two eighth notes and then a **dotted half note**, held for three beats: "1-and 2 3 4". The next bar has two quick-quick-long groups: eighth, eighth, quarter, twice.

blocks.title: Hurt's intro rhythm
blocks.about: Rhythm mode: any key counts; only the timing is judged. Left hand, bars 1–4.
blocks.doneWhen: 80% of the notes on time in one run

blocks.text:
# Its notes, by letter
The same intro on the keys: **A E A**, **C G C**, **D A D**, low on the keyboard, with your left hand. Each group goes up from a low note to the same letter above it.

blocks.title: Hurt's intro, by key names
blocks.about: Two phrases of letters, left hand.

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **You rush the rests.** Count them out loud: rests are beats too.
- **The long note in Hurt is cut short.** Keep your finger down through "2 3 4".

**Until the next lesson:** both rhythms once a day.
